Name: Guxelbit's Catalog
Author: guxelbit
Description:
From [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20268]Guxelbit’s Furniture[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20384]Chest Deco[/url] combined together using Content Patcher & Calcifer
[b][size=3]
What’s New:
[/size][/b][b]
[/b][spoiler][b]
   Rewrite the config file:
[/b]• Changed some furniture IDs.
• Furniture now can be placed anywhere.
• Instead of choosing only one color (Oak, Walnut,etc) you can use everything together.
• Storage Decorations (originally Chest Deco) now have it’s own config, you can choose one or more type to add to the game or completely disabled it.
• Simplify item description.
• Fixed some error.

[b]   Assets file:
[/b]• Added 10 new furniture (with each colors of wood).
• Fixed some overlapping texture.
• Fixed some texture bug.
[/spoiler]

This mod requires:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer
[/url]Recommended using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] for easy search and placement of the furnitures.


Original code by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NARCOAZAZAL]Narco[/url] , Thank you so much for helping me <3
